clue.text: Coppers back rank plan in advance

parts.note: coppers are pennies, abbreviated P
the back is the rear
a rank or row is a range

explanation.surface: Police officers at the rear of the ranks map out an operation beforehand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Coppers' suggests police, but here it means copper coins, pennies, abbreviated P.
explanation.definitionFit: To arrange something before it happens is to settle the plan ahead of time.

clue.text: A dance that's staggering!

definitions.meaning: the verb sense: lurching, swaying unsteadily

explanation.definitionFit: It is both a Scottish country dance and a verb for lurching about, as if drunk.

clue.text: No aid's required by the handsome fellow

indicators.note: the words are required to be rearranged, so the letters of the fodder are reworked

explanation.surface: A good-looking man needs no help at all.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth this youth was loved by Aphrodite for his beauty, so the name stands for any good-looking man.

clue.text: Plainly most embarrassed bearing with a minister in idleness

indicators.note: the bearing and minister are placed in the word for idleness

parts.note: idleness is rest
E, east, is a compass bearing
DD, Doctor of Divinity, is a minister's degree

explanation.surface: Someone is visibly mortified at being caught lazing about with a clergyman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plainly' signals that the embarrassment shows, as in a blush.
explanation.definitionFit: Blushing deeply shows embarrassment, so the most flushed face is the most visibly mortified.

clue.text: Mean to approach

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both an adjective for stingy and a verb for drawing closer.

clue.text: Enduring, though without any objective

definitions.meaning: read literally: lacking an aim or goal

explanation.definitionFit: It means everlasting, and read in two parts it says having no goal.

clue.text: When riots erupt school-head might well show moral fibre

indicators.note: the riots erupting throws these letters into disorder

parts.note: the head of the word school is S

explanation.surface: A headteacher who calmly handles a rebellion at school would demonstrate real character.
explanation.walkthrough: 'school-head' looks like a headteacher, but it gives only the first letter of 'school'.
explanation.definitionFit: Integrity and being deserving are both kinds of principled character.

clue.text: US town, Princeton say

indicators.note: say marks an example: a prince, for instance one called Charles, stands in its place

explanation.surface: Princeton is offered as an example of a town in America.
explanation.walkthrough: Princeton is itself a US town, which tempts you to look no further; instead swap its 'Prince' for a named example, Charles.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a city in South Carolina, and another in West Virginia.

clue.text: See small child in the water

parts.note: lo is an old word for look or see
CH is a short form of child

explanation.surface: Look at the little one playing in the water.
explanation.definitionFit: A Scottish lake is a body of water.

clue.text: Support a worker on the watch

parts.note: to second a motion is to support it
a hand is a worker, as in farmhand

explanation.surface: Backing a labourer who is keeping guard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on the watch' sounds like keeping guard, but it is a timepiece, which has a pointer for the seconds.
explanation.definitionFit: A watch carries a pointer that sweeps round marking seconds.

clue.text: Refuse a stretcher

definitions.meaning: an old word for a stretcher carrying the sick

explanation.definitionFit: It is rubbish dropped in the street and also a frame for carrying a patient.

clue.text: Press it anyway, go on!

indicators.note: the letters are to be arranged any way, so they are jumbled

explanation.surface: Push it regardless, carry on!
explanation.definitionFit: To continue doggedly is to keep going.

clue.text: He steps out with due regard for the dog

parts.note: pace, from Latin, means with deference to
a setter is a gun dog

explanation.surface: A man walks off politely making way for the dog.
explanation.walkthrough: PACE (two syllables) is the Latin-derived word used in phrases like 'pace my critics', meaning with respect to them.
explanation.definitionFit: A runner who sets the speed for others in a race strides out ahead.

clue.text: Dealing with urgent checking

parts.note: re means concerning or dealing with
something pressing is urgent

explanation.surface: Handling a matter that cannot wait.
explanation.definitionFit: Holding something back or restraining it is a form of keeping it in check.

clue.text: Charges dropped in some sorrow

definitions.meaning: drops of weeping that fall when sad

explanation.definitionFit: The word is a verb for rushing along and a noun for the drops shed in grief.

clue.text: Witless, and that's a serious shortcoming in the Orient

parts.note: a sin is a grave moral failing
E, east, is the Orient

explanation.surface: Being foolish is considered a grave failing in the East.
explanation.definitionFit: Silly or stupid people have no wits about them.

clue.text: Gather a large number take dope

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand
a dope is a fool, an ass

explanation.surface: A crowd assembles to take drugs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dope' suggests drugs, but it is a fool.
explanation.definitionFit: To collect or accumulate is to gather together.

clue.text: Leaves written matter for the players

parts.note: tea is dried leaves
MS is manuscript

explanation.surface: Leaves notes in writing for the performers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leaves' reads as a verb but is the noun: tea leaves.
explanation.definitionFit: Sides in a sport are made up of players.

clue.text: Making a point about copy

parts.note: C, circa, means about
to ape is to copy

explanation.surface: Someone imitates to make an argument.
explanation.definitionFit: A headland jutting into the sea is called a point.

clue.text: Handled certain material

annotationWithheld.why: Clue 'Handled certain material (4)' reads as a double definition for FELT (handled; a fabric), not the printed answer PELT; neither handled nor material gives the P.

clue.text: "X" is far from pleased

definitions.meaning: the mark made by two ... lines

explanation.definitionFit: An X is a mark of two crossed strokes, and the word also means annoyed.

clue.text: Church set disconcerted about the French being blue

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
le is French for the

indicators.note: the set is disconcerted, thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A church congregation upset at the French becoming sad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blue' looks like sadness after 'disconcerted', but it is the colour; 'disconcerted' jumbles 'set', and 'about' and 'being' only join the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Sky blue is one meaning, from the French word for heavenly.

clue.text: Maintained outside right should be initiated

indicators.note: the word for maintained sits outside the R

parts.note: to maintain a view is to state it

explanation.surface: Claims a right-winger should be begun.
explanation.definitionFit: Something initiated has been begun.

clue.text: Puts off quiet little people

parts.note: sh is the call for quiet
elves are the little people of folklore

explanation.surface: Silent fairies postpone things.
explanation.definitionFit: To shelve a plan is to set it aside for later.

clue.text: One member of the family walks ahead

parts.note: steps is walks
on means forward, ahead

explanation.surface: A relative strides forward.
explanation.definitionFit: A spouse's child from an earlier marriage is part of the household.

clue.text: Flighty creature given young salmon to raise

parts.note: a parr is a young salmon

indicators.note: in a down clue, raising lifts the word upward so it reads backwards

explanation.surface: A bird is fed a little salmon to bring it up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to raise' in a down clue reverses TO, giving OT.
explanation.definitionFit: A talking bird can fly, so it is a creature of flight.

clue.text: As a healthy drink freshly-brewed tea's "in"

indicators.note: the tea's letters and in are newly brewed, mixed up afresh

explanation.surface: Brewed tea is fashionable as a health drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A herbal infusion is drunk for its wellness benefits.

clue.text: Course for an ethnic group

definitions.meaning: a channel or watercourse, as a millrace

explanation.definitionFit: It is a channel of running water and a group of people sharing descent.

clue.text: Free from all unsound odds and ends

annotationWithheld.why: Clue 'Free from all unsound odds and ends (4)': no reading of the remaining words gives the letters U N D O; likely misprinted.
annotationWithheld.clue: Free from all unsound odds and ends

clue.text: Produce notes about a topping craftsman's cracking up

indicators.note: the singing goes round the hat maker

parts.note: to sing is to produce musical notes
a hatter makes toppers, hats

explanation.surface: A hat maker going to pieces sings.
explanation.definitionFit: Breaking into fragments is cracking up.

clue.text: Some poacher nervously taking a bird

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A nervous poacher catches a bird.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft's definition took in 'taking', but that is a link word; the definition is 'a bird'.
explanation.definitionFit: A sea eagle is a bird.

clue.text: Improvement might be made in tone

indicators.note: the letters might be rearranged into another word

explanation.surface: Something could be improved by speaking differently.
explanation.definitionFit: A correction to a text is an improvement.
